intro: How to audit your resume with AI is a practical guide for job seekers. It focuses on decisions that affect the final result: setup time, correction effort, privacy, export control, cost, and the human review step. Product details should be checked against each vendor before publication.
workflow: Collect factual examples from your real experience and target role.
Use AI to organize and clarify those examples, not to invent achievements.
Check privacy, spelling, dates, metrics, and claims before submitting.
Track the version, result, and feedback so the next application improves.
verdict: For job seekers, start with one narrow task and compare the shortlisted tools using the same evidence. Keep the smallest workflow that improves the final result after corrections.

faq.q: Can AI write my resume?
faq.a: AI can organize and edit your evidence, but it should not invent experience, metrics, skills, or credentials.

faq.q: Should I use the same resume for every job?
faq.a: Start from one master resume, then tailor the summary, evidence order, and keywords honestly for each role.

faq.q: What should I remove before using an AI job tool?
faq.a: Remove unnecessary personal identifiers, references, private employer information, and any data the tool does not need.
